document.name: La Central YMCA — Traditional Summer Camp (2026)
document.shortDescription: La Central YMCA runs weekday summer camp in Mott Haven with traditional, kinder, swim, and Zookeepers tracks for children ages 4 through 12.
document.longDescription:
The La Central YMCA publishes 2026 summer camp at 434 Westchester Avenue in Mott Haven, with two-week sessions from June 29 through August 21, 2026. The official page lists camp hours as 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. and extended hours from 8 a.m. to 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. to 6 p.m., which supports weekday morning, afternoon, and after-school tags.

The camp page lists Traditional Summer Camp for ages 6-12, Kinder Camp for ages 4-5, Swim Camp for ages 8-12, and Zookeepers Camp for ages 5-7. Published descriptions highlight physical fitness, arts and crafts, science activities, group play, and specialized animal-focused programming with zoo visits and swim lessons.

Published community tuition for one two-week Traditional Summer Camp session is $714; Kinder Camp is listed at $799 community, Swim Camp at $828 community, and Zookeepers Camp at $1,200 community. Camp leadership contact on the official page is Tasia Brown at lacentral@ymcanyc.org and (718) 530-5403.

Sources: https://ymcanyc.org/locations/la-central-ymca/summer-camps https://ymcanyc.org/locations/la-central-ymca https://ymcanyc.org/sites/default/files/styles/hero_banner_desktop/public/2025-12/2026_camp_music2.jpg.webp?itok=c0GXd3Xk
